$comment: Curated manifest of publicly reachable documents about magnetocaloric cooling.
The repository commits this list, not the text. `npm run ingest` fetches each
URL at seed time, extracts the readable body, chunks it, embeds it, and stores
it in your own database — so no third-party prose is redistributed here, and
every answer the agent gives can cite the URL it actually came from.
`sourceRef` is the short handle the agent cites and the eval golden set keys
on. Keep it stable: changing one invalidates the expected answers.
